description: Split a PDF into several files: one per page by default, every N pages, or one file for each page range. Files are saved beside the original unless output_folder is set.

every.description: Start a new file every this many pages. Defaults to 1.

input.description: Path of the PDF to split.

output_folder.description: An existing folder for the new files. Defaults to the original's folder.

overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it already exists. Defaults to false.

ranges.description: One file per range, such as ["1-3", "4-10", "11-"].

name: pdf_split
title: Split a PDF
